items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I worked with Fate in a little joint down in the area where the ballpark is now.

ctx.x: Um-hmm. I played with Fate. I played with Fate. Fate came to town. His name used to be Fate Marble – M-a-r-b-l-e, but he put another A behind the R, made himself Marable, but he was Fate Marble when he first came to St. Louis. His thing was that he never was able to settle down until he primed himself with a couple of slugs of whiskey. It used to be so strange. He lived close to a bar, but instead of having a jug by his bed to wake up, he’d get up and hurriedly, before he brushed his teeth, put on – sometimes in…
He had a similar thing, that I read about, when he would – when somebody was going to be put out of his band.
